query:
UPDATE pages
           SET title = COALESCE($3, title),
               slug = COALESCE($4, slug),
               updated_at = CASE
                   WHEN (COALESCE($3, title), COALESCE($4, slug)) IS DISTINCT FROM (title, slug)
                   THEN timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond'
                   ELSE updated_at END
           WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
